remarks: An excellent opportunity awaits with this income-generating multi-family property, offering versatility, value, and long-term potential. Each unit provides comfortable living spaces with 2 bedrooms each, including separate living and dining areas, full kitchens, and full bathrooms, making them highly appealing to tenants and owner-occupants. This property is ideal for buyers looking to generate rental income or stay in one unit and rent out the other. With both units currently occupied by tenants, the property delivers immediate cash flow and eliminates the hassle of finding renters after closing. Whether you’re a first-time investor or an experienced buyer searching for a solid addition to your portfolio, this turnkey property presents a rare opportunity to secure steady income and future growth potential in one package.
